projects.title: Machinify
projects.subtitle: Listening to machines before they fail.
projects.description: Sensor data meets AI to help predict industrial machine failures. A Flutter mobile experience brings monitoring and alerts closer to the people who need them.
notes: AI-powered predictive maintenance using industrial sensor data to anticipate equipment failures.
Contributed to unit and white-box testing, including boundary and branch coverage.
Explored fault-injection scenarios to validate system behavior; graduation project graded A+.

projects.title: ProgUp
projects.subtitle: A little more structure. A little less stress.
projects.description: An AI scheduler combining tasks, Pomodoro sessions, and personalized recommendations through a Flutter app and Flask backend.
notes: JWT authentication and REST APIs for tasks and schedules.
RandomForestRegressor model to support personalized recommendations.
Integrated calendar tasks and Pomodoro activities into one workflow.

projects.title: Dr. Ashraf Clinic
projects.subtitle: A clearer connection between doctor and patient.
projects.description: A healthcare management application supporting appointments, prescriptions, and patient records. Built with a Flask backend and MySQL, with Firebase Cloud Messaging and a Gemini-powered chatbot.
notes: Appointment booking and prescription workflows for a clinic management experience.
Firebase Cloud Messaging supports appointment reminders.
Gemini-powered chatbot assists users within the application.

projects.title: Job Portal QA
projects.subtitle: Following the happy path. Then leaving it.
projects.description: Exploratory and functional testing, responsive checks, and Selenium automation for a multi-role job portal. Finding the unexpected—and making it reproducible.
notes: Covered job seeker, company, and admin workflows during manual testing.
Automated valid and invalid login scenarios and job search using Selenium and pytest.
Used explicit waits and reusable driver fixtures; documented issues with clear reproduction steps.

experience.text: Tested multi-role job portal workflows, responsive behavior, and AI-assisted features. Created Selenium / Python / pytest checks for smoke, login, and job search; documented defects and retest results.
Coach learners on freelancing, portfolio development, proposal writing, and professional profiles through weekly sessions, practical assignments, and measurable goals.

Tested web and mobile features for functionality, validation, usability, and visual consistency. Performed regression, cross-browser, responsive, and RTL checks; documented defects and verified fixes with developers.
Delivered project-based Python and mBlock sessions for Grade 6 students. Mentored 100+ learners in programming fundamentals, structured problem solving, and computational thinking.
Completed 210 hours of MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, and Node.js training, building full-stack applications with authentication and database integration.
Developed backend services with Sanic and Docker, working with Oracle databases and Linux administration as part of the internship rotation at the Magdi Yacoub Foundation.
Assisted with SQL report automation, daily IT operations, and Linux administration tasks.
